_about: Simulated web for eval/discovery_eval.py. Everything here is fictional (Quarrywick Wealth, its staff, AdvisorQuill, the UK namesake). Real platform hosts appear only as URL shapes; nothing is fetched. A doc is 'relevant' when it is a third-party page about OUR firm that a compliance officer would want to review. pattern_synthetic, reviewed: false.

scenarios.note: How the demo is actually hosted: own site under a GitHub Pages subpath; the AdvisorQuill demo per DEVIN_THIRD_PARTY.md would likely be another repo on a github.io account.
Control: same pages served at the root of their own domain. Isolates the subpath problem from everything else.
